para.text: In those cases the X and Y co-ordinates are treated as 'normal' 2D X and Y co-ordinates, either in user co-ordinates or in absolute screen co-ordinates. The Z co-ordinates become meaningless.

para.text: Due to the possible complex nature of the object clipping is performed by the Windows API clipping function. However there is no equivalent in metafiles*. Therefore I have developed a ClipPoly routine that creates a clipped polygon for use in metafiles. This routine is kept simple but should work fine for ordinary (=convex) polygons.
